document.heading: Street Names – Authority to Change Suffix
An Ordinance Concerning Street Names – Authority to Change Suffix

para.heading: Guidelines.
para.text: In naming or changing the name of any street, avenue, or other thoroughfare, the following guidelines shall be observed:
the name may not be the same as the name of an existing street, avenue, or thoroughfare;
the name may not be the name of a living person or persons;
the name may not be the name of an existing or proposed business or of an existing or proposed product of a business;
the name shall be given to the entire length of the street, avenue, or thoroughfare; and
the street suffix may be changed for a given block or set of blocks to better describe the character of the street, avenue, or thoroughfare.
